question: People who enrolled in Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act get work for how many days?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**100 days**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA)** was implemented in **2005** by the Government of India.<
